training.early_stopping_location: external controller at completed epoch boundary; native patience remains zero
training.monitor: each member FP16 hflip2 AP-only Study Macro-AUC
training.rule: Score each initialization as E0 under its own arm preprocessing. Complete E1; skip E2 unless AP-only E1 minus E0 is strictly greater than 0.0001. If E2 runs, end at hard maximum two epochs.
training.checkpoint_selection: highest observed AP-only AUC among E0,E1,and E2 if run; ties prefer earlier epoch
training.note: No more hyperparameter adjustments after scores. Independently early-stopped members can have different realized epochs. Seed, initialization, max budget and policy remain paired.

validation.ap_only: all view_position values in a Study are AP
validation.primary: fixed Tiny/Base fusion AP-only Macro-AUC B minus A
validation.sampling_unit: patient with all Studies, while aggregation remains strictly within Study
validation.selection_bias: AP-only now used for stopping/selection; resulting valid comparisons and bootstrap are exploratory and do not correct selection bias or establish online generalization

orchestration.native_stop_marker: Write STOP only after epoch starts; wait full validation/checkpoint and process exit. Remove STOP before exact continuation.
orchestration.exact_resume: original last.pt plus optimizer/scaler/RNG; do not rewrite original checkpoint metadata
